category_edits.rationale: Expand the GELU feed-forward intermediate width from 2× to 4× hidden_units in every bidirectional Transformer block across all four category models. This tests greater nonlinear capacity while preserving pre-norm attention, residuals, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically constructs matching checkpoint shapes.

response.change_summary: Double BERT4Rec feed-forward intermediate width for each category’s single model; training and prediction share the updated architecture.
